title: After-Hours Reservation Voice Agent
summary: Answer reservation calls at night and during the front desk rush in Hindi and English, check availability, send payment links and route in-house guest issues to the duty manager.

seo.title: After-Hours Hotel Reservation Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: AI voice agent that answers hotel calls after hours, checks availability and rates, takes bookings with payment links and escalates urgent calls.

problem.intro: Many independent hotels run the night shift with one person doing the night audit, handling late arrivals and answering the phone. Calls about tomorrow's availability, early check-in or directions ring out or get rushed answers, and travellers who cannot get through book somewhere else.

pain_points.title: Missed calls at night and at peak hours
pain_points.detail: Late-night and early-morning calls, and calls during the evening check-in rush, go unanswered or get a hurried reply.

pain_points.title: Repetitive questions crowd out real work
pain_points.detail: Check-in time, parking, distance from the railway station, pet policy and breakfast timing take the night auditor away from arrivals and the audit.

pain_points.title: Bookings taken without payment
pain_points.detail: Night bookings promised over the phone without an advance turn into no-shows that block rooms.

pain_points.title: Urgent calls mixed with routine ones
pain_points.detail: An in-house guest reporting a problem and a caller asking about rates reach the same busy line.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that answers your reservation line after hours, or whenever the front desk does not pick up within a set number of rings. It speaks Hindi, English or Hinglish, answers questions from your hotel's approved information, checks live availability and rates, and takes a reservation by collecting name, dates, guests and room type. It sends a payment link by SMS or WhatsApp for the advance and confirms the booking once paid. Existing guests can modify or cancel within your policy after verification. Calls from in-house guests, emergencies and anything outside its scope are transferred to the duty manager's phone at once.
capabilities: Answers overflow and after-hours calls on your existing hotel number
Natural conversation in Hindi, English and Hinglish
Live availability and rate lookup with reservation capture
Payment link by SMS or WhatsApp, with no card details taken over the phone
Booking changes and cancellations within policy after caller verification
Immediate transfer of in-house guest issues and emergencies to the duty manager

workflow.title: Answer the call
workflow.detail: Calls ring at the front desk first; unanswered or after-hours calls are picked up by the agent, which identifies itself as the hotel's AI assistant.

workflow.title: Understand the request
workflow.detail: The agent works out whether the caller wants a new booking, a change, information or help during a stay.

workflow.title: Escalate urgent calls
workflow.detail: In-house guests, emergencies and complaints are transferred straight to the duty manager.

workflow.title: Check and quote
workflow.detail: For new bookings it checks availability and rates in the PMS and explains inclusions and policies.

workflow.title: Collect the advance
workflow.detail: It sends a payment link by SMS or WhatsApp and holds the room for a set time.

workflow.title: Confirm and log
workflow.detail: On payment the booking is created in the PMS, and every call gets a summary for the morning shift.

inputs: Inbound calls on the hotel reservation number
Live availability, rates and policies from the PMS
Approved hotel information: location, facilities, timings
Duty manager roster and phone numbers
outputs: Reservations created in the PMS after payment
Payment links sent and their status
Transfers to the duty manager with the reason
Morning report of calls, bookings and promised callbacks
human_in_the_loop: The duty manager takes every in-house guest call, emergency and complaint immediately. The morning shift reviews the call report and handles callbacks the agent has promised, such as group enquiries or special requests.
integrations: Hotel PMS such as eZee, Hotelogix, IDS or Opera
Cloud telephony such as Exotel, Knowlarity or Twilio
Payment gateway with UPI payment links
WhatsApp Business API and an SMS gateway
Duty manager mobile phones for transfers
guardrails: Identifies itself as an AI assistant at the start of every call
Never takes card numbers or UPI PINs over the phone
Verifies booking reference and phone number before any change or cancellation
Transfers immediately on emergency keywords or when the caller asks for a person
Quotes only rates and policies returned by the PMS or approved by management
compliance_notes: Call recordings and guest details are personal data under the DPDP Act 2023; callers are told calls are recorded, and recordings follow a set retention period.
Payments are taken through links on a regulated payment gateway, which keeps card and UPI credentials out of the call.

pilot.scope: Overflow and night calls on one property's reservation number, with every call reviewed daily by the front office manager.
deliverables: Call flows and hotel information base
Voice agent connected to telephony, PMS and payment links
Transfer rules for the duty manager

what_we_measure.how: Calls answered versus calls received in the pilot window, compared with missed-call logs from before the pilot.
Paid reservations created from agent-handled calls.
Front office review of transferred and non-transferred calls for the right decision.
Short post-call SMS rating and review of a sample of recordings.

faqs.q: Do we need to change our phone number?
faqs.a: No. Your existing number forwards to the agent when the front desk does not answer, or during the hours you choose. Calls can still be transferred back to staff.

Emergency words and any call from an in-house guest trigger an immediate transfer to the duty manager's phone, with a fallback number if the first does not answer. The agent does not try to resolve emergencies itself.
It is tested on recordings with the accents and code-mixing typical of your callers. When it does not understand after a retry, it offers a callback or a transfer rather than guessing.

faqs.q: Is it affordable for a small hotel?
faqs.a: Pricing is a one-time setup plus a usage-based running cost that depends on call minutes. The pilot measures your actual minutes and bookings, so you can judge the cost against the business it brings.
